item.description: Providing bursts of blooms in spring and a canopy of shade in summer, Bowral's avenue of soldier-like trees is being tested by disease.

item.title: LIV Golf ending season early after cancelling final event
item.description: LIV Golf is ending its season one week earlier than planned, announcing on Monday it will not hold the team championship in Michigan next week and instead crown the team champion this week.

item.title: Labour hire company and four farms face over $3 million in fines in Supreme Court legal case
item.description: A major labour hire legal case is set to begin in the Victorian Supreme Court and could see those accused face fines totalling more than $3 million.

item.title: Luigi Mangione's state murder trial postponed indefinitely amid double jeopardy fight
item.description: Luigi Mangione's lawyers have described him as a "pawn in parallel prosecutions" and accused state and federal prosecutors of "trying to punish him twice for the exact conduct".

item.title: Mourners call for probe into former Cambridge professor Jason Arday's death

item.title: Fungi fans celebrate its recognition as nature's third living kingdom

item.title: Four Sydney Swans players linked to Melbourne incident that sparked police investigation
item.description: The ABC understands Chad Warner, Isaac Heeney, James Jordon and Riley Bice are the players linked to the investigation, although there is no confirmation that they were directly involved or that all four have spoken to police.

item.title: Hockeyroos defeated by the Netherlands in FIH Hockey World Cup pool match
item.description: The Hockeyroos have been beaten by the Netherlands in their second match of the FIH Hockey World Cup, going down 4-2 despite a battling performance against the reigning champions.

item.title: Bringing Symphony of Stories to life with music and costumes for Book Week

item.description: One Nation says high taxes on tobacco have pushed Australians into the black market, and the only way to undo that is by cutting the price of cigarettes in half.

item.title: Cameron Smith and Kevin Walters out of Queensland Maroons' coach search

item.title: Josh Fraser named Carlton coach after leading Blues' AFL revival

item.title: The taboo experience of motherhood regret
